name: Ehud
overview: Ehud, a Benjamite and descendant of Benjamin, is identified in Scripture as a significant figure among the families of Benjamin, possibly linked with names such as Ehi and Ahiram (Genesis 46:21; Numbers 26:38). Notably, Ehud is remembered as the courageous assassin of Eglon, the Moabite king, who crafted a double-edged dagger and concealed it on his right thigh to carry out his mission (Judges 3:16). His story highlights God's providential deliverance of Israel through unlikely instruments within the tribe of Benjamin.
